instruction.text: Oscar wrote down all the relevant information he found on the website. What should he not forget to do now? Select the correct answers.

b: ++make a note of the website where he found the information
tell his friends that he has completed the homework

feedback.end: The internet is a good place for finding information; however, not everything you read is true. Some information might be out of date or simply incorrect. Images and videos can also be faked!

atoms.text: In order to check whether information is true when doing an internet search, it is good to look at several websites and compare them with one another.

instruction.text: Select the publication date of this article.

feedback.end: On most articles, you can find a publication date. If the publication date is very old, you should probably use another website.
